Demonstrated experience with procurement processes, purchase orders, and expense reimbursements.
Prior experience working within the University of California (UC) system.
Experience managing Health Sciences accounts, badge processing, and specialized research recharge billing.
Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly financial reports, manage purchasing and reimbursements, process subaward invoices, and administer patient gift card incentives.
Handle administrative and facility logistics, including key issuance, mail distribution, badge processing, Health Sciences account setup, and faculty travel arrangements.
Process recharge transactions for shared research equipment and manage inter-site research collaborations.
Support research faculty with seminar coordination, scholarly activity tracking, and ongoing maintenance of faculty CVs.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for complex data management and financial reporting.
Proven ability to multitask and deliver accurate administrative and financial support in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with academic research operations, subaward administration, and faculty support workflows.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
